description_en: Modifies the specifications or storage space of ApsaraDB for MongoDB standalone instances, replica set instances, and serverless instances. Serverless instances are supported only on the China site
description_zh: 变更云数据库MongoDB单节点实例、副本集实例和Serverless实例（仅中国站支持Serverless实例）的规格或存储空间
name: ModifyDBInstanceSpec

parameters.help_en: The instance ID
parameters.help_zh: 实例ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The instance type. <props="intl"><ph>For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/57141.html. You can also call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/149719.html operation to query instance types.</ph></props>
<props="china">
For standalone instances and replica set instances, this parameter specifies the instance type. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/57141.html. You can also call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/149719.html operation to query the instance types of standalone instances and replica set instances.
For serverless instances, this parameter specifies the compute specifications of the instance. Valid values: 100 to 8000.
</props>

You must specify at least one of the DBInstanceClass and DBInstanceStorage parameters
parameters.help_zh:
实例规格。<props="intl"><ph>详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/57141.html。您也可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/149719.html接口查看实例规格。</ph></props>
<props="china">
单节点实例和副本集实例配置为实例的规格，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/57141.html。您也可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/149719.html接口查看单节点实例和副本集实例的实例规格。
Serverless实例配置为实例的计算规格，取值范围为100~8000。
</props>

该参数和DBInstanceStorage参数两者中至少配置一项
parameters.name: db_instance_class

parameters.help_en:
The instance storage. <props="intl"><ph>Valid values: 10 to 3000. Unit: GB. Step size: 10 GB. The valid values are subject to the instance type. For details, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/57141.html.</ph></props>

<props="china">
For standalone instances and replica set instances, valid values are 10 to 3000. Unit: GB. Step size: 10 GB. The valid values are subject to the instance type. For details, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/57141.html.
For serverless instances, valid values are 1 to 100. Unit: GB. Step size: 1 GB.
</props>

You must specify at least one of this parameter and the DBInstanceClass parameter.
You cannot decrease the quota of storage space
parameters.help_zh:
实例的存储空间。<props="intl"><ph>取值范围为10~3000 GB，步长为10 GB。具体取值受实例规格约束，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/57141.html。</ph></props>

<props="china">
单节点实例和副本集实例存储空间的取值范围为10~3000 GB，步长为10 GB。具体取值受实例规格约束，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/57141.html。
Serverless实例存储空间的取值范围1~100 GB，步长为1 GB。
</props>

该参数和DBInstanceClass参数两者中至少配置一项。
目前不支持降配存储空间
parameters.name: db_instance_storage

parameters.help_en:
The type of the configuration change. Valid values:
UPGRADE: upgrades the configurations. This is the default value.
DOWNGRADE: downgrades the configurations.

This parameter is available only when the billing method of the instance is subscription
parameters.help_zh:
变配类型，取值说明：
UPGRADE：默认值，升级配置。
DOWNGRADE：降级配置。

当实例付费方式为包年包月时，可以配置该参数
parameters.name: order_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable automatic payment for the instance. Valid values:
true: enables automatic payment. This is the default value. Make sure that your account has sufficient balance.
<props="china">- false: disables automatic payment. You can manually pay for the order in the ApsaraDB for MongoDB console. Log on to the console, choose Expenses > Expenses and Costs in the upper-right corner, choose Purchase Orders > My Orders in the left-side navigation pane, and then find the target order on the Product Orders tab to complete the payment.</props>
<props="intl">- false: disables automatic payment. You can manually pay for the order in the ApsaraDB for MongoDB console. Log on to the console, choose Expenses > Expenses and Costs in the upper-right corner, click Order Management in the left-side navigation pane, and then find the target order on the Product Orders page to complete the payment.</props>
parameters.help_zh:
实例是否自动付费，取值说明：
true：默认值，自动付费，请确保账号有足够的余额。
<props="china">- false：控制台手动付费。您可以登录云数据库MongoDB控制台，在页面右上角选择费用 > 费用与成本，在左侧导航栏，选择订购订单>我的订单，在商品订单页签找到目标订单进行支付。</props>
<props="intl">- false：控制台手动付费。您可以登录云数据库MongoDB控制台，在页面右上角选择费用 > 费用与成本，在左侧导航栏，单击订单管理，在商品订单页面找到目标订单进行支付。</props>
parameters.name: auto_pay

parameters.help_en: The business information
parameters.help_zh: 业务信息
parameters.name: business_info

parameters.help_en:
The number of nodes in the instance. Default value: 3.
For a replica set instance, valid values are 3, 5, and 7.
For a standalone instance, the value is fixed to 1.
For a replica set instance that uses shared storage (supported only on the China site), the value is fixed to 2.

You do not need to specify this parameter for a serverless instance (supported only on the China site)
parameters.help_zh:
设置实例的节点个数，默认值为3。
副本集实例取值为3，5，7。
单节点实例取值固定为1。
共享存储版副本集实例（仅支持中国站）取值固定为2。

Serverless实例（仅支持中国站）不需要配置该参数
parameters.name: replication_factor

parameters.help_en:
The number of read-only nodes. Valid values: 0 to 5.

If the network type of the instance includes only the classic network and VPC, you must enable Internet access or release the classic network before you can change the number of read-only nodes.
You can log on to the ApsaraDB for MongoDB console and view the enabled network types on the Database Connections page
parameters.help_zh:
只读节点的个数，取值范围为0~5。

如果实例的网络类型只开通了经典网络和专有网络，您需要开通公网或释放经典网络，才能变更只读节点数。
您可以登录云数据库MongoDB控制台，在数据库连接页面查看已开通的网络类型
parameters.name: readonly_replicas

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use a coupon. Valid values:
default or null: uses a coupon. This is the default value.
youhuiquan_promotion_option_id_for_blank: does not use a coupon
parameters.help_zh:
是否使用优惠券，取值说明：
default或null（默认）：使用优惠券。
youhuiquan_promotion_option_id_for_blank：不使用优惠券
parameters.name: coupon_no

parameters.help_en:
The effective period of the configuration change. Valid values:
Immediately: takes effect immediately. This is the default value.
MaintainTime: takes effect during the maintenance window of the instance
parameters.help_zh:
变更配置的生效时间，取值说明：
Immediately：默认值，立即生效。
MaintainTime：在实例的可运维时间段内生效
parameters.name: effective_time

parameters.help_en:
The additional parameter. Valid values:

async: returns the result after the configuration change order is created.
sync: returns the result when the configuration change is delivered to the instance after the order is created
parameters.help_zh:
附加参数，取值说明：

async：变配订单创建后返回结果。
sync：变配订单创建后实例变配下发时返回结果
parameters.name: extra_param

parameters.help_en:
The destination active zone for instance migration during a configuration change across zones.
<notice>This parameter is supported only for cloud disk instances.</notice>
<notice>The value of this parameter cannot be the same as the value of the TargetSecondaryZoneId or TargetHiddenZoneId parameter.</notice>
You need to specify this parameter only during a configuration change across zones.
The destination zone and the current zone of the instance must be in the same region.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/61933.html operation to query zone IDs
parameters.help_zh:
迁移可用区同时变配时，实例迁移的目标可用区。
<notice>只支持云盘实例。></notice>
<notice>该参数取值不能与TargetSecondaryZoneId和TargetHiddenZoneId参数值相同。></notice>
只有在迁移可用区同时变配才需要传入此参数。
迁移的目标可用区和当前实例的可用区处于同一地域。
您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/61933.html接口查询可用区ID
parameters.name: target_zone_id

parameters.help_en:
The destination zone for the secondary node when you cloud disk instance across zones and change its configurations at the same time.
<notice>This parameter is supported only for instances that use cloud disks.</notice>
<notice>The value of this parameter cannot be the same as the value of the TargetZoneId or TargetHiddenZoneId parameter.</notice>

You need to specify this parameter only when you cloud disk instance across zones and change its configurations at the same time.
This parameter is available only for multi-zone migration.
The destination zone and the current zone of the instance must be in the same region.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/61933.html operation to query zone IDs
parameters.help_zh:
迁移可用区同时变配时，从节点（Secondary节点）的目标可用区。
<notice>只支持云盘实例。></notice>
<notice>该参数取值不能与TargetZoneId和TargetHiddenZoneId参数值相同。></notice>

只有在迁移可用区同时变配才需要传入此参数。
本参数仅在多可用区迁移时可用。
迁移的目标可用区和当前实例的可用区处于同一地域。
您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/61933.html接口查询可用区ID
parameters.name: target_secondary_zone_id

parameters.help_en:
The destination zone for the hidden node when you cloud disk instance across zones and change its configurations at the same time.
<notice>This parameter is supported only for instances that use cloud disks.</notice>
<notice>The value of this parameter cannot be the same as the value of the TargetZoneId or TargetSecondaryZoneId parameter.</notice>


You need to specify this parameter only when you cloud disk instance across zones and change its configurations at the same time.
This parameter is available only for multi-zone migration.
The destination zone and the current zone of the instance must be in the same region.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/61933.html operation to query zone IDs
parameters.help_zh:
迁移可用区同时变配时，隐藏节点（Hidden节点）的目标可用区。
<notice>只支持云盘实例。></notice>
<notice>该参数取值不能与TargetZoneId和TargetSecondaryZoneId参数值相同。></notice>


只有在迁移可用区同时变配才需要传入此参数。
本参数仅在多可用区迁移时可用。
迁移的目标可用区和当前实例的可用区处于同一地域。
您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/61933.html接口查询可用区ID
parameters.name: target_hidden_zone_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to automatically align the primary node to the primary zone after operations such as configuration changes for a multi-zone instance. If you choose not to align the node, one primary/secondary switchover (transient disconnection) is avoided. Default value: true, which indicates that the node is aligned
parameters.help_zh: 控制多可用区实例在变配等操作后是否自动将 Primary 节点对齐至主可用区。选择不对齐可减少一次主备切换（闪断），默认为 true（对齐）
parameters.name: align_primary_zone

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the destination vSwitch when you cloud disk instance across zones and change its configurations at the same time.
<notice>This parameter is supported only for instances that use cloud disks.</notice>

You need to specify this parameter only when you cloud disk instance across zones and change its configurations at the same time
parameters.help_zh:
迁移可用区同时变配的目标虚拟交换机ID。
<notice>只支持云盘实例。></notice>

只有在迁移可用区同时变配才需要传入此参数
parameters.name: target_vswitch_id

parameters.help_en: The node specifications of the search node for the configuration change
parameters.help_zh: 变配的Search节点规格
parameters.name: search_node_class

parameters.help_en: The storage capacity of the search node for the configuration change
parameters.help_zh: 变配的Search节点容量
parameters.name: search_node_storage

parameters.help_en: The number of search nodes for the configuration change
parameters.help_zh: 变配的Search节点数
parameters.name: search_node_count

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request and prevent duplicate submissions. You can generate the value of this parameter on the client side. The value must be unique across different requests and can be up to 64 ASCII characters in length. The value cannot contain non-ASCII characters
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过 64 个 ASCII 字符，且该参数值中不能包含非 ASCII 字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run on the request. Valid values:
true: performs a dry run without calling the operation. The system checks the request parameters, request format, business limits, and inventory. If the request fails the dry run, the corresponding error is returned. If the request passes the dry run, the DryRunOperation error code is returned.
false: sends the normal request and directly performs the operation after the request passes the check. This is the default value
parameters.help_zh:
是否对本次请求执行预检查，取值：
true：执行预检查，不真正调用该接口。检查项包含请求参数、请求格式、业务限制和库存等。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误；如果检查通过，则返回错误码 DryRunOperation。
false（默认）：发送正常请求，通过检查后直接执行本次操作
parameters.name: dry_run
